name: ntulearn-wooclap-notifier
description: Chrome extension that notifies you when an open WOOCLAP session shows a new answerable question.

scripts.check: node --check src/detector-core.js && node --check src/ntfy-core.js && node --check src/bark-core.js && node --check src/content-script.js && node --check src/service-worker.js && node --check src/popup.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json', 'utf8')); console.log('manifest valid')"
